profile.headline: Software Developer at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory
profile.summary:
Software Developer with 5+ years of experience in Python, Java, C/C++, and CI/CD for high-performance computing. Adept at managing robust software infrastructure, authoring and enforcing software quality assurance standards, and providing technical guidance and support to multidisciplinary teams. 

Seeking leverage expertise in software infrastructure, quality assurance, and collaborative problem-solving to contribute to innovative projects and support cross-functional teams in a dynamic, growth-oriented organization.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Managed the Python registry, associated utilities, and CI/CD infrastructure for internal Python software tools for 6+ projects and repositories, ensuring seamless integration and deployment.
•	Led the development and implementation of automated deployment systems utilizing Docker between internal networks, improving deployment speed by 50% with an uptime of 98% uptime.
•	Developed, debugged and maintained software environments to support engineers, analysts, and developers across 3 teams on High-Performance Computing systems.
•	Authored and enforced Software Quality Assurance guidelines to ensure consistent software development standards group-wide based on DOE O 414.1D and NAP 401.1A. 
•	Peer reviewed 200+ pull requests, resolved 75+ user requests and provided technical direction for multiple projects.
•	Received 2 SD Bronze Awards and 1 ASQ Spot Award.
•	Received mentorship in applying Aerospace Engineering, Material Science, and Modeling principles to develop software solutions for technical and engineering applications.

company.name: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: •	Assisted Object Oriented Programming Java Master’s Level Course for Information Management.

positions.title: Computer Science Receptionist
positions.description:
•	Developed a moderation system used for the communication platform Discord to connect professors school organizations and administrations to students during the pandemic.
•	Implemented new office procedures for rapid transition between fiscal years.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Algorithmic Analysis, Tile Self-Assembly. Research determined if sub problems are nondeterministic polynomial-time complete to prove if current problem is.
•	Investigated algorithmic efficiency of tile self-assembly algorithms, contributed to research proposals.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
•	Built a memory allocation library using file memory systems for runtime allocation under the Umpire Memory Allocation Resources Development Team.
•	Benchmarked CPU, GPU, and file memory allocation efficiency; presented findings to LLNL Summer SLAM.

positions.title: IT Summer Internship Manager
positions.description:
•	Maintained educational equipment and performed routine upgrades.
•	Implemented community program to introduce and coach low performing high school graduates.

organizations.name: ACM-W
organizations.description:
The Association for Computing Machinery's Council on Women in Computing (ACM-W)
supports, celebrates, and advocates internationally for the full engagement of women in all aspects
of the computing field.

organizations.name: Xtreme Algorithms
organizations.description:
Our organization focuses on the research and presentation of difficult computer science problems.
Most of our members have attended conferences nationwide and recently internationally. I was
also tasked with the management of the web page.
